summary.zh: 桌面主界面布局重构：工作台主体移到左侧、聊天记录限定在当前工作台、运行期信息卡片整合为右上悬浮胶囊、聊天搜索改为顶部入口加居中搜索界面、输入区控制按钮重排为一条工具栏。上下文用量环新增真实分类明细，并跨会话持久保存。修复设置/关于页开关偶发卡在加载状态的问题。
summary.en: The desktop main chat UI is rearranged: the workspace panel moves to the left, chat history is scoped to the current workspace, runtime info cards collapse into a floating capsule at the top right, chat search becomes a top entry with a centered search overlay, and input-area controls are regrouped into a single toolbar. The context usage ring now shows a real category breakdown that persists across sessions. Also fixes settings/About toggles occasionally stuck in a loading state.

title.zh: 主聊天界面布局重构
title.en: Main chat layout refactor

summary.zh: 重新编排桌面端主聊天界面：工作台主体从右侧移到左侧，聊天记录限定为当前工作台的会话；原本散落的运行期信息卡片整合为一个右上角悬浮信息胶囊，可按需展开；聊天搜索从侧栏入口改为标题栏顶部入口，打开后是居中的搜索界面；输入区控制按钮重新归组为一条工具栏，侧栏入口与标题栏同步重排。
summary.en: The desktop main chat surface is rearranged: the workspace panel moves from the right to the left, and chat history is scoped to the current workspace's sessions. Scattered runtime info cards collapse into one floating capsule at the top right that expands on demand. Chat search moves from the sidebar to a top-bar entry opening a centered search overlay. Input-area controls are regrouped into a single toolbar, with sidebar entries and the title bar rearranged to match.

details.zh: 只重排既有功能，不新增产品能力；移动端布局同步适配。
details.en: Existing features are only rearranged, no new product capabilities added; the mobile layout adapts in sync.

details.zh: 输入区原控制条（InputControlBar）由新工具栏组件（ComposerToolbar）取代。
details.en: The old input control bar (InputControlBar) is replaced by the new ComposerToolbar component.

sources.title: feat(desktop): 聊天界面布局重构 + 上下文用量分类详情

title.zh: 上下文用量分类明细
title.en: Context usage category breakdown

summary.zh: 输入区的上下文用量环现在展示真实的分类明细：各消息类别（如系统提示、对话、工具、记忆等）按统一契约估算占比，而非此前的单一总量。明细随会话持久保存，切换会话或重启应用后仍然保留，上下文压缩后相应清空。
summary.en: The context usage ring now shows a real category breakdown: message classes (system prompt, conversation, tools, memory, etc.) are estimated under a unified contract instead of a single total. The breakdown persists with the session — it survives switching sessions and app restarts, and is cleared when context is compacted.

details.zh: 分类估算契约以 lib/llm 与 shared 单一事实源落地，服务端与桌面端共用。
details.en: The estimation contract lives as a single source of truth shared between lib/llm and shared/, used by both server and desktop.

sources.title: feat(desktop): 聊天界面布局重构 + 上下文用量分类详情

title.zh: 修复设置/关于页开关卡在加载状态
title.en: Fix settings/About toggles stuck loading

summary.zh: 修复冷启动时设置页与关于页开关（Toggle）偶发一直显示加载中的问题：设置初始化并行化后，依赖当前助手身份的快照请求在助手数据就绪前发出，导致空身份快照固化。现在这类请求严格等待助手加载完成后再发起。
summary.en: Fixes toggles on the settings and About pages occasionally stuck loading on cold start: after settings initialization was parallelized, snapshot requests that depend on the current agent identity fired before agent data was ready, persisting an empty-identity snapshot. Such requests now strictly wait for agents to load first.

sources.title: feat(desktop): 聊天界面布局重构 + 上下文用量分类详情

summary.zh: 设置里的「用量」页升级为「模型观测」工作台：可按时间、模型、供应商、会话等维度筛选，查看每次模型调用的详情、请求与响应载荷、以及按真实时间排布的调用轨迹时间线，并支持导出（默认关闭，需在设置中显式开启）。修复了情绪与思考内容偶发回流聊天正文、模型凭证串用隐患、以及 mac 上自动更新安装失败的问题；应用图标与界面视觉全面焕新，设置供应商页加载大幅提速。
summary.en: The Usage page in settings is upgraded to a Model Observatory workbench: filter model calls by time, model, provider or session, inspect per-call details, request/response payloads, and a call-trace timeline laid out on a real time axis, with export support (disabled by default; opt in from settings). Fixes landed for mood/think segments occasionally leaking back into chat text, model credential boundary gaps, and macOS auto-update installation failures; the app icon and visual identity are refreshed, and the providers settings page loads much faster.

title.zh: 模型观测工作台：看清每一次模型调用
title.en: Model Observatory: see every model call

summary.zh: 设置中的「用量」页升级为完整的模型观测工作台。可按时间预设（24 小时/7 天/30 天/自定义/全部）、模型、供应商、状态等维度组合筛选，查看调用量、耗时、token 用量与成本等聚合指标；点击任意调用可展开检查器，查看各次尝试、请求与响应载荷（脱敏后）、以及归属的调用轨迹。
summary.en: The Usage page becomes a full Model Observatory workbench. Combine filters across time presets (24h/7d/30d/custom/all), model, provider and status; review aggregate metrics for call volume, latency, token usage and cost; open any call in the inspector to see its attempts, redacted request/response payloads, and the trace it belongs to.

details.zh: 隐私优先：观测默认关闭，需在设置中显式开启；载荷记录与二进制 blob 预览各自单独 opt-in。
details.en: Privacy first: observability is off by default and must be enabled in settings; payload capture and blob preview each require a separate opt-in.

details.zh: 相对时间预设的窗口在选中瞬间冻结，分页浏览时结果不再随时间漂移。
details.en: Relative time presets freeze their window the moment they are selected, so paginated results no longer drift over time.

details.zh: 支持按查询条件流式导出 JSONL，便于离线分析。
details.en: Streaming JSONL export for the current query enables offline analysis.

summary.en: Trace details gain a timeline chart that lays model calls on a real time axis with hover details; the date grouping upgrades from bars to a smooth line chart positioned by real date proportions, with hover tooltips and adaptive axis labels.

summary.en: Closes model-call and credential boundary gaps across the codebase: temporary credentials no longer leak across the model call they belong to, removing credential cross-use hazards.

summary.en: On macOS, auto-updates of ad-hoc signed builds silently skipped installation because the updater's verification structurally fails; they now go through a self-install path that reliably swaps and relaunches after download. The path retires itself once proper Developer ID signing is configured.

summary.en: Fixes the blank delay on the providers settings tab: the summary endpoint's O(N²) aggregation is now single-pass, cutting multi-provider load times from seconds to tens of milliseconds.

sources.title: fix(chat): 保留标签管道 raw 单次消费与历史段净化边界

summary.zh: 新增「记忆梦境」：助手会在后台自动整理长期记忆，设置里可以查看每次整理的版本并对比变化；聊天渲染管线重构为单通道语义流，长会话更流畅、显示更准确；归档对话恢复显示真实标题，并支持手动勾选批量删除。
summary.en: Introducing Memory Dream: your assistant now consolidates long-term memory in the background, with revision history and diffs in settings; the chat rendering pipeline was rebuilt around a single semantic channel for smoother, more accurate long conversations; archived chats show their real titles again and can be bulk-deleted by manual selection.

title.zh: 记忆梦境：后台自动整理长期记忆
title.en: Memory Dream: background long-term memory consolidation

summary.zh: 助手现在会在后台像做梦一样自动整理长期记忆，把零散的印象合并成清晰的要点；设置中新增记忆梦境控制项与版本浏览器，可查看每次整理的版本并对比与当前记忆的变化。
summary.en: Your assistant now consolidates long-term memory in the background, merging scattered impressions into clear facts. Settings gain Memory Dream controls and a revision browser where you can review each consolidation and diff it against current memory.

details.zh: 每个助手拥有独立的梦境整理核心，并与灵犀记忆槽位打通。
details.en: Each agent gets its own Dream consolidation core, integrated with the Lingxi memory slot.

details.zh: 版本浏览器支持查看当前记忆与任一历史版本的差异对比。
details.en: The revision browser can diff current memory against any historical revision.

title.zh: 聊天渲染管线重构：长会话更流畅
title.en: Chat rendering pipeline rebuild: smoother long conversations

summary.zh: 聊天渲染链路重构为单通道语义流，解析前移、消息语义归一化，长会话渲染更流畅、内容显示更准确。
summary.en: The chat rendering pipeline was rebuilt around a single semantic channel with front-loaded parsing and normalized message semantics, making long conversations render smoother and more accurately.

details.zh: 流式更新按语义发布，Markdown 从增量源渲染，避免重复解析整段历史。
details.en: Stream updates publish by semantics and markdown renders from an incremental source, avoiding re-parsing the whole history.

details.zh: 重型历史渲染延后执行，滚动与加载大量消息时明显更顺滑。
details.en: Heavy history rendering is deferred, noticeably smoothing scrolling and loading of large message lists.

sources.title: feat(chat): consolidate semantics pipeline with canonical single channel
perf(chat): defer heavy history rendering

summary.en: Fixed archived chats all showing as “New chat” — titles now fall back to each conversation's first message. Archive management gains checkboxes for manual multi-select bulk deletion, beyond the 30/90-day cleanup options.

details.zh: 标题回退链路与主侧边栏一致：自定义标题优先，其次首条消息。

details.zh: 同时修复了缓冲区内多个心情段可能互相覆盖的问题。

title.zh: 循环任务全程可见、可控制
title.en: Loop tasks are visible and controllable end to end

summary.zh: 循环任务的进度现在直接显示在气泡上（第几轮、共几轮），气泡上就能暂停、恢复或停止；会话列表为运行中的循环显示常驻徽章，鼠标悬停（或触屏上直接）可以停止它；状态变化实时推送，重启应用后徽章依然在。
summary.en: Loop progress now appears right on the bubble (current turn out of total), with pause, resume and stop controls in place; the session list shows a persistent badge for active loops with a stop affordance on hover (always visible on touch); status changes stream in real time and survive app restarts.

details.zh: 循环气泡显示「第 X / M 轮」，老会话的历史循环消息也能识别。
details.en: Loop bubbles show 'turn X of M', including loop messages from older sessions.

details.zh: 运行中徽章带脉冲动画、已暂停为琥珀色；减少动态效果模式下自动关闭动画。
details.en: The badge pulses while running and turns amber when paused; animations are disabled under reduced-motion.

details.zh: 预览其他会话时，循环控制按钮只作用于它所属的会话，不会误停当前会话的循环。
details.en: When previewing another session, loop controls only act on the session they belong to — they cannot stop the wrong loop.

sources.title: feat(loop): loop visibility, controls, and start-prompt bubble

title.zh: 发起循环时输入的任务不再「凭空消失」
title.en: The task you type when starting a loop no longer vanishes

summary.zh: 以前输入 /loop 加任务内容后，聊天里看不到自己写了什么。现在它会像普通消息一样显示在右侧，重新打开会话也还在；同时它被特殊保存，绝不会被重复发给模型，不会干扰循环的执行。
summary.en: Previously, after typing /loop with a task, your input disappeared from chat. It now appears on the right like a normal message and stays after reopening the session; it is stored specially so it is never re-sent to the model or interferes with the loop.

details.zh: 即使经过会话压缩，模型也不会收到重复的任务内容。
details.en: Even across conversation compaction, the model never receives the task text twice.

sources.title: feat(loop): loop visibility, controls, and start-prompt bubble

title.zh: 新会话里直接输入 /loop 等命令不再报「应用内部出了点问题」
title.en: Typing /loop or similar commands in a brand-new session no longer errors

summary.zh: 在还没发过消息的新会话里直接输入 /loop 之类的命令，以前会提示「应用内部出了点问题」。现在会先把会话建好再执行命令，和正常发消息的行为一致。
summary.en: Typing a command like /loop in a session that has no messages yet used to fail with a generic internal error. The session is now created first and the command runs, matching how sending a normal message behaves.

sources.title: feat(loop): loop visibility, controls, and start-prompt bubble

title.zh: 模型调用失败时的用量记账更准确
title.en: More accurate usage accounting for failed model calls

summary.zh: 模型请求失败但返回了部分用量数据时，以前会被记为一次成功调用。现在这类请求会正确记为失败，并保留失败原因，用量与费用统计更真实。
summary.en: When a model request failed but still returned partial usage data, it used to be counted as a successful call. Such requests are now correctly recorded as failures with their error reason, making usage and cost statistics more truthful.

sources.title: fix(usage): record provider errors with precedence over usage

summary.zh: 本版本让循环任务在聊天中清晰可见：启动、继续和通知都会显示为气泡，不再像凭空消失；同时新增多家模型供应商预设（Qwen Token Plan、Z.AI、蚂蚁百灵、MiniMax 国际版、小米 MiMo 国际节点等），配置模型更省事。
summary.en: Loop tasks are now visible in chat: kickoff, wakeup and notice events appear as bubbles instead of vanishing. This release also adds many new provider presets (Qwen Token Plan, Z.AI, Ant Ling, MiniMax International, Xiaomi MiMo international nodes and more), making model setup easier.

title.zh: 循环任务在聊天中实时可见
title.en: Loop tasks are now visible in chat in real time

summary.zh: 以前启动循环任务后，你输入的任务内容会从聊天界面消失，看起来像消息丢了。现在循环任务的启动、每次唤醒继续和暂停/终止通知都会显示为一条气泡，点开来还能看到任务详情。
summary.en: Previously, after starting a loop task your input disappeared from the chat as if the message was lost. Loop kickoff, each scheduled wakeup, and pause/termination notices now appear as bubbles, with task details available on click.

details.zh: 新发起的循环任务会立即插入一条「循环任务已启动」气泡，不必等下次进入会话才看到。
details.en: Starting a loop task immediately inserts a 'loop task started' bubble — no need to re-enter the session to see it.

details.zh: 历史会话中的旧循环消息也会补显出任务内容，中英文界面均生效。
details.en: Loop messages from older sessions are backfilled with their task content as well.

sources.title: feat(loop): surface loop kickoff/wakeup/notice as interlude bubbles

title.zh: 新增多家模型供应商预设
title.en: More model provider presets

summary.zh: 添加供应商时可选的预设更多了：Qwen Token Plan（国际/国内/个人版）、Moonshot 国际版、MiniMax 国际版、小米 MiMo Token Plan 新加坡与阿姆斯特丹节点、Z.AI Coding（国际/国内）和蚂蚁百灵（Ant Ling）。界面文案也统一为「供应商」。
summary.en: More presets when adding a provider: Qwen Token Plan (intl/CN/individual), Moonshot International, MiniMax International, Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan SGP/AMS nodes, Z.AI Coding (intl/CN), and Ant Ling. UI wording for providers was unified as well.

details.zh: 新预设自带正确的 Base URL 与 API 协议，填入 API Key 即可读取模型列表。
details.en: Each new preset ships the correct Base URL and API protocol — just paste an API Key and fetch the model list.

sources.title: feat(providers): add token-plan/z.ai/ant-ling presets and unify provider wording

summary.zh: 本版本修复了 Windows 上偶尔出现的文件写入失败，确保配置可靠保存；同时统一了模型服务商的管理状态，避免了删除或切换时的界面不同步，并让技能徽章在历史记录和重试后依然保留。
summary.en: This release fixes occasional file write failures on Windows, unifies provider management state to prevent UI desync, and ensures skill badges persist across history and retries.

title.zh: 修复 Windows 上配置文件写入偶发失败
title.en: Fixed occasional config file write failures on Windows

summary.zh: 在 Windows 系统中，写入配置文件（如模型列表）时可能因为安全软件或索引程序暂时占用文件而失败。现在会自动重试，并在需要时删除目标文件以确保成功。
summary.en: On Windows, writing config files (like the model list) could fail when antivirus or indexer temporarily held the file. Now the write automatically retries and may remove the target file between attempts to ensure success.

details.zh: 配置写入失败时自动重试，最多 8 次，并会在每次重试前删除目标文件，以应对 Windows 对重命名操作的严格锁定。
details.en: Automatically retries up to 8 times, and removes the destination file before each retry to handle Windows' stricter locking on rename operations.

details.zh: 如果重试后仍然失败，会明确报错，避免用户误以为保存成功。
details.en: If the retries are exhausted, it clearly throws an error so failed writes are never reported as successful.

sources.title: fix(secret-fs): widen Windows rename retry budget and unlink target between tries
fix(secret-fs): retry transient EPERM rename on Windows

title.zh: 统一模型服务商管理，修复界面状态不同步
title.en: Unified provider management to fix UI state desync

summary.zh: 现在左侧菜单的模型服务商列表始终根据已保存的配置显示，不再受本地历史选择影响。删除服务商时状态会正确收敛，失败的删除也会保留卡片。设置窗口中的模型下拉菜单也共享同一份运行时状态，无需手动刷新。
summary.en: The left rail's provider list now always reflects the saved provider catalog, not local selection history. Deleting a provider converges from authoritative state, and failed deletes keep the card. The settings window's model dropdowns share a single runtime state, so no manual refresh is needed.

details.zh: 删除服务商时，界面会从权威状态更新，不会再出现已删除项仍残留的情况。
details.en: When deleting a provider, the UI updates from authoritative state, so no deleted entries linger.

details.zh: 等待异步认证信息写入后再刷新模型列表，并防止旧的背景刷新覆盖新状态。
details.en: Waits for async credential writes before refreshing models and prevents stale background refreshes from overwriting newer state.

details.zh: 识别并拒绝返回错误 JSON 的 HTTP 2xx 响应，避免保存失败却被视为成功。
details.en: Rejects HTTP 2xx responses that contain an error JSON, so failures never look successful.

sources.title: fix(settings): unify provider catalog and runtime model state

title.zh: 技能徽章在历史记录和重试后保持显示
title.en: Skill badges persist across history and retries

summary.zh: 会话中的技能徽章现在会正确保存，并在查看历史消息或重试/恢复对话时继续显示。从父会话分叉出的子会话也能看到相应的技能信息。
summary.en: Skill badges in a session are now saved correctly and remain visible when viewing history or retrying/resuming a conversation. Forked child sessions also see the skills from the parent.

details.zh: 显示记录中携带技能列表，历史投影能正确还原用户消息上的技能信息。
details.en: Display records carry the skill list, and the history projection restores skill info on user messages.

details.zh: 重试/恢复路径会保留技能信息，分叉会话复制相同的显示记录。
details.en: The retry/restore path preserves skills, and forking copies the same display record.

sources.title: fix(session): persist skill badges across history and retries
build(persistence): repin schema fingerprint for skill list fields

summary.zh: 本版本修复了旧安装未能正确更新组件导致 Artifact 无法激活的问题，并增强了运行时信息显示和发布前的质量检查，确保安装与升级更稳定可靠。
summary.en: This release fixes an issue where older installations could not activate Artifact after update, improves runtime diagnostics, and adds preflight checks to make installation and upgrades more robust.

source.releaseNotes: LingxiAgent v0.1.24 contains intended product changes since v0.1.3. Key fixes include repairing Artifact activation for installations running older renderer/server, and adding runtime provenance and compatibility warnings. Release preflight now blocks product-version regression and ensures migration tests pass. Dependency updates removed critical/high npm audit findings. Digest generation moved to DeepSeek API as infrastructure.

title.zh: 修复 Artifact 激活问题
title.en: Fix Artifact activation issue

summary.zh: 解决了安装新版后仍使用旧渲染器/服务导致 Artifact 无法激活的问题，同时保留用户数据与崩溃回滚机制。
summary.en: Resolves an issue where Artifact could not activate because older renderer/server remained in use after update, while preserving user data and crash rollback.

details.zh: 新发布的激活流程会自动修复旧安装，确保升级后组件一致。
details.en: The new activation flow automatically repairs old installations to ensure component consistency after upgrade.

sources.title: release: repair artifact activation and harden 0.1.23
The user-facing repair fixes Artifact activation for installations that kept running the older 0.1.22 renderer/server

title.zh: 增强运行时诊断信息
title.en: Enhanced runtime diagnostics

summary.zh: 现在可以更方便地查看当前使用的 Shell、渲染器、服务器、版本、训练与提交信息，帮助排查兼容性问题。
summary.en: Easier access to active shell, renderer, server, version, train, and commit information to help diagnose compatibility issues.

details.zh: 新增兼容性警告，当检测到版本不匹配时会明确提示。
details.en: Compatibility warnings now appear when version mismatches are detected.

sources.title: Runtime provenance and compatibility warnings now make the active shell, renderer, server, source, version, train, release generation and commit visible

title.zh: 发布前新增质量检查
title.en: New preflight quality checks

summary.zh: 在构建和发布前自动阻止版本回退、标签与包不匹配等问题，并要求通过引导与升级迁移测试，提升可靠性。
summary.en: Automatically blocks version regressions, tag/package mismatches, and requires bootstrap and migration tests to pass before build and publication.

details.zh: 这些检查有助于避免无效发布，减少用户遇到安装问题的风险。
details.en: These checks help prevent invalid releases and reduce the risk of installation issues.

sources.title: Release preflight now blocks product-version regression, tag/package mismatch and release-generation reuse
release: fix Linux gate and advance to 0.1.24

title.zh: 安全依赖更新
title.en: Security dependency updates

summary.zh: 更新了依赖，消除了所有严重和高危的 npm 审计问题，同时避免强制升级可能带来风险的中低危项目。
summary.en: Updated dependencies to eliminate all critical and high npm audit findings, while avoiding forced upgrades of moderate/low risk items.

details.zh: 保持了兼容性，未采用不安全的强制升级方案。
details.en: Compatibility is maintained without unsafe forced upgrades.

sources.title: Compatible dependency updates removed all critical and high npm audit findings

summary.zh: 本次更新完善了发布流程：版本摘要生成已迁移至 DeepSeek，并修复了摘要中混入模型推理文本的问题；同时对 0.1.23 的发布产物激活进行了修复和加固。
summary.en: This release improves the release workflow: digest generation now uses DeepSeek, and a fix prevents model reasoning text from leaking into the digest; it also repairs and hardens 0.1.23 artifact activation.

title.en: Digest generation migrated to DeepSeek

summary.zh: 应用内更新说明的生成流程已迁移到 DeepSeek 模型。
summary.en: The in-app release digest generation has been migrated to the DeepSeek model.

details.zh: 版本摘要现在由 DeepSeek 模型生成，以替代原有流程。

summary.zh: 修复了生成摘要时可能混入模型推理文本的问题，只保留最终摘要内容。
summary.en: Fixed an issue where model reasoning text could leak into the digest, so only the final summary is shown.

summary.en: Fixed the release artifact activation flow and hardened 0.1.23 for more reliable releases.

details.zh: 发布产物激活已修复，避免新版本无法正常使用。
details.en: Release artifact activation has been repaired to prevent issues with the new version.

details.zh: 对 0.1.23 进行额外加固，提升发布可靠性。
details.en: Additional hardening for 0.1.23 improves release reliability.

summary.zh: 0.1.3 是继 0.1.2 之后的正式版本，汇入此前预览版验证过的设置界面、本地模型增强、辅助模型分工和审批安全改造，并同步上游 openhanako 0.444.1 与 pi SDK 0.84.1。本次还修复了审批材料可能泄露凭证、本地模型能力识别失效和探测请求无界并发等问题；GitHub Release 与稳定更新通道会同步推进。
summary.en: 0.1.3 is the stable release following 0.1.2. It brings together the settings redesign, local-model enhancements, role-based auxiliary models, and approval security work previously exercised in preview builds, while syncing openhanako 0.444.1 and pi SDK 0.84.1. It also fixes possible credential exposure in approval context, broken local-model capability detection, and unbounded metadata probes. The GitHub Release and stable update channel advance together.

title.en: Redesigned provider, model, and usage settings

summary.zh: 设置界面重新组织供应商、模型和用量信息，设置窗口会按内容自适应，权限审批文案也更容易理解。

summary.zh: 本地模型可自动读取上下文长度，并正确声明工具调用、结构化输出和思考能力；上下文参数只在安全范围内注入。
summary.en: Local models can discover context length and correctly expose tool use, structured output, and reasoning capabilities, with context parameters applied only when safely bounded.

details.zh: 能力信息改从模型详情响应读取；模型列表先去重，最多探测 200 个，并把并发限制为 6，避免本地或远端服务被瞬间压满。
details.en: Capabilities now come from model-detail responses; model IDs are deduplicated, probes are capped at 200, and concurrency is limited to six to avoid overwhelming local or remote services.

fix(audit): 修复 Ollama 能力来源、探测并发和上下文边界

title.zh: 不同后台任务可使用各自合适的辅助模型
title.en: Purpose-fit auxiliary models for background tasks

summary.zh: 标题、总结、记忆、看图、审批和安全检查可以分别选择模型。未配置时沿用聊天模型；明确配置但不可用时会直接报错，不再悄悄换模型。
summary.en: Titles, summaries, memory, vision, approvals, and safety checks can use separate models. Unconfigured roles inherit the chat model, while an explicitly configured but unavailable model now fails visibly instead of silently switching.

refactor(aux-model): 辅助模型 Semantic Slot 收口修复

title.zh: 审批最终决定收回本机，并补齐凭证脱敏
title.en: Host-enforced approvals with stronger credential redaction

summary.zh: 审批模型只负责给出授权判断，真正的允许、询问或拒绝仍由本机规则决定。发往审批模型的命令、对话证据和授权摘要会统一遮住常见令牌、密码与云服务凭证。
summary.en: The approval model now supplies only an authorization assessment; local policy still makes the final allow, ask, or deny decision. Commands, conversation evidence, and authorization summaries sent for review now consistently redact common tokens, passwords, and cloud credentials.

details.zh: 范围更宽或无法判断的授权会降为询问用户，格式或网络失败也不会自动放行。
details.en: Broader or unclear authorization is downgraded to asking the user, and formatting or transport failures never become automatic approval.

sources.title: refactor(approval): 权限审批改为单一 Intent Authorization Reviewer
fix(audit): 审批材料统一执行保守凭证脱敏

summary.en: Skill-card-only messages are no longer dropped, model-sync failures remain observable, dependency import guards now cover side-effect imports, and runtime defaults consistently use the Lingxi brand.

summary.zh: 0.1.2 修复 0.1.0 在 macOS 上无法启动的严重问题。根因是 CI 在无 Apple 证书时走 ad-hoc 签名路径，但只重签了主程序与 Helper，漏签了 Electron Framework——主程序（无 Team ID）与 Framework（Electron 官方 Team ID）Team ID 不一致，macOS dyld 在加载 framework 时直接终止进程，表现为双击无反应/闪退。本次在 electron-builder 的 afterSign 钩子里补全全量 ad-hoc 重签，统一包内所有 Mach-O 组件的签名身份，启动恢复正常。注：0.1.1 因 afterSign 配置写成数组（该版本 electron-builder 不支持）导致 CI 构建失败，未发布成功；0.1.2 改为单个 afterSign 入口在内部编排重签+公证后修复。
summary.en: 0.1.2 fixes a critical issue where 0.1.0 could not launch on macOS. The root cause: CI's certificate-less ad-hoc signing path re-signed only the main executable and Helpers, leaving Electron Framework with its original Electron Team ID. The Team ID mismatch between the main process (no Team ID) and the framework (Electron's Team ID) caused macOS dyld to terminate the process while loading the framework — appearing as a silent crash on launch. This release adds a full ad-hoc re-sign step in electron-builder's afterSign hook, unifying the signing identity of every Mach-O component in the bundle, so the app launches normally. Note: 0.1.1 failed CI because afterSign was configured as an array (unsupported by this electron-builder version) and was never published; 0.1.2 fixes it with a single afterSign entry that orchestrates resign + notarize internally.

title.zh: 修复 macOS 启动崩溃：统一 ad-hoc 签名 Team ID
title.en: Fix macOS launch crash: unify ad-hoc signing Team ID

summary.zh: 新增 electron-builder afterSign 重签逻辑（resign-adhoc.cjs），在无 Apple 证书时把包内所有 Mach-O 组件（Electron Framework、各 Helper、computer-use helper、主程序）统一重签为 ad-hoc，消除主程序与 Framework 的 Team ID 不一致——这正是 0.1.0 在 macOS 上 dyld 加载 framework 即 SIGABRT 的根因。该逻辑由唯一的 afterSign 入口 notarize.cjs 在公证之前编排调用（electron-builder 26.8.x 的 afterSign 不支持数组配置）。同时把 CI 里被硬编码为常开的 SKIP_NOTARIZE 改为「仅在无公证凭据时跳过」，配齐 Apple 凭据后可无缝切到正规签名+公证。
summary.en: Adds an electron-builder afterSign re-sign step (resign-adhoc.cjs) that, when no Apple certificate is present, re-signs every Mach-O component in the bundle (Electron Framework, Helpers, computer-use helper, main executable) to a unified ad-hoc identity, eliminating the Team ID mismatch between the main process and the framework — the root cause of 0.1.0's dyld SIGABRT on macOS launch. The logic is orchestrated by the single afterSign entry notarize.cjs before notarization (electron-builder 26.8.x does not support array afterSign configs). The CI's hardcoded-always-on SKIP_NOTARIZE is also corrected to 'skip only when notary credentials are absent', so adding Apple credentials later switches to proper signing + notarization with no further changes.

details.zh: 崩溃报告铁证：codeSigningTeamID 为空（主程序 ad-hoc），加载 Electron Framework 时报 'mapping process and mapped file have different Team IDs'，启动 30ms 内被 dyld 终止。
details.en: Crash report evidence: codeSigningTeamID was empty (ad-hoc main process), and loading Electron Framework failed with 'mapping process and mapped file have different Team IDs' — dyld terminated the process within 30ms of launch.

details.zh: 0.1.1 教训：afterSign 写成数组 [a.cjs, b.cjs]，但 electron-builder 的 resolveFunction 只接受 string，数组被原样注册为事件处理器，emit 时崩溃，CI 构建失败未发布。0.1.2 改为 notarize.cjs 单入口，内部 require 并调用 resignAdhoc。
details.en: 0.1.1 lesson: afterSign was written as an array [a.cjs, b.cjs], but electron-builder's resolveFunction only accepts a string; the array was registered as-is as the event handler and crashed on emit, failing CI. 0.1.2 uses notarize.cjs as the single entry, which requires and calls resignAdhoc internally.

summary.zh: 灵犀（Lingxi）以 0.1.0 正式起步。这一版完成了从 HanaAgent 到灵犀的品牌焕新：新图标、新角色卡，窗口与应用各处的品牌名统一为 Lingxi；老用户的个人数据目录会自动从 ~/.hanako 迁移到 ~/.lingxi，不需要手动搬动。版本号从上游 0.442.0 归零，重启为独立的 0.1.0 版本线，关于页新增「上游项目 / 上游版本」记录，标明本项目同步的上游 openhanako 及其版本。本次同时清理了大量重构遗留，发布与更新渠道迁移到 LingxiAgent 仓库。
summary.en: Lingxi starts its own version line at 0.1.0. This release completes the rebrand from HanaAgent to Lingxi: a new icon, new character cards, and the Lingxi name now appears everywhere from window titles to notifications. Existing users' data directory is migrated automatically from ~/.hanako to ~/.lingxi. The version number resets from the upstream 0.442.0 to an independent 0.1.0 line, and the About page now records the upstream project (openhanako) and the version it tracks. Plenty of refactoring leftovers were cleaned up, and the release/update channel moved to the LingxiAgent repository.

title.zh: 品牌焕新：HanaAgent 正式更名为灵犀 Lingxi
title.en: Rebrand: HanaAgent is now Lingxi

summary.zh: 新图标与角色卡替换了占位图，窗口标题、通知、开机页等所有用户可见处的品牌名统一为 Lingxi，桌面端打包产物与签名路径也一并对齐。
summary.en: A new icon and character cards replace the placeholders, and every user-visible surface — window titles, notifications, splash — now consistently reads Lingxi, with packaging and signing paths aligned.

details.zh: 图标、角色卡等视觉资产全部换成灵犀专属设计（2048 母图 + Windows/macOS 全尺寸）。
details.en: All visual assets — app icon and character cards — are now Lingxi-specific (2048px master plus full Windows/macOS size sets).

details.zh: 用户可见品牌名残留统一：窗口标题、快速问答、通知、开机页均使用 Lingxi。
details.en: User-visible brand leftovers were unified: window titles, quick chat, notifications and splash all say Lingxi.

sources.title: feat(stage-6): replace AI-generated brand assets (icon + character cards)
fix(stage-7): unify window titles to Lingxi + macOS packaging hooks

title.zh: 老用户数据目录自动迁移：~/.hanako → ~/.lingxi
title.en: Automatic data-dir migration: ~/.hanako → ~/.lingxi

summary.zh: 老用户的个人数据会整体从 ~/.hanako 搬迁到 ~/.lingxi，迁移过程登记持久化豁免，随时可安全重试；CLI 与桌面端的数据目录行为已对齐为 .lingxi。
summary.en: Existing users' data moves wholesale from ~/.hanako to ~/.lingxi; the migration is registered as a persistent exemption and can be safely retried, and CLI and desktop now agree on the .lingxi data directory.

details.zh: 首次启动时自动检测并搬迁旧目录，无需手动操作；CLI 本地服务的数据目录也统一为 .lingxi。
details.en: The old directory is detected and moved on first launch with no manual steps, and the CLI local server now uses .lingxi too.

summary.zh: 版本号从上游 0.442.0 归零重启为 0.1.0，灵犀从此拥有独立版本线；设置 > 关于 新增「上游项目 / 上游版本」两行，标明同步的上游项目 openhanako 与当前同步的版本（0.442.0）。
summary.en: The version resets from upstream 0.442.0 to an independent 0.1.0 line; Settings > About now shows the upstream project (openhanako) and the exact upstream version (0.442.0) this build tracks.
